# Sudan test restricted to observed days (generated by scripts/posthoc_observed_days.py)

Post-hoc diagnostic on the already-used test set; no retraining or re-selection. Rules fixed in `results/posthoc_observed/PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `c954d71`) before these numbers were computed.

Neural/ensembles: mean ± sample std over seeds 1–3. MASE = MAE / MAE(persistence) on the same pairs. DM vs persistence: HLN, Newey–West lag h − 1, p for seeds 1/2/3 with sign (− lower loss than persistence). Verdict: sign agrees and p < 0.05 in all three seeds. DA = direction vs last observed value, non-zero true changes only.

All h target days observed: 0 windows at h = 7 and h = 30 (not reportable); identical to S1 at h = 1.

## Decision on H (preregistered: S1, absolute loss, 18 selected configurations)

- "worse" than persistence: 18/18 on the full test set → **11/18 on S1**
- median seed-mean MASE on S1: **1.263**
- Rule: supported if ≤ 6 worse and median MASE ≤ 1.00; not supported if ≥ 12 worse; partly otherwise.
- **Decision: H partly supported.**
